title: Restaurant Table Booking
desc: Donna handles inbound calls, checks availability, captures party size + dietary notes, and confirms reservations directly into the calendar.
scenario: "Hi, I'd like a table for 4 on Saturday at 8pm — and one of us is gluten-free."

title: HVAC Emergency Dispatch
desc: Triages inbound emergency calls, prioritises by urgency (no heat / leak / installation), captures address + contact, and books the next available technician.
scenario: "My boiler is leaking and the kids' rooms are freezing. How fast can someone come?"

title: Clinic Appointment Triage
desc: Greets patients, identifies symptoms vs administrative requests, books appointments with the right specialist, and follows HIPAA-compliant scripting.
scenario: "I've had a sore throat for four days and a slight fever. Should I see someone?"

title: Premium Brand Product Advisor
desc: Walks customers through the catalog, recommends models based on budget + usage, captures order details, and offers warranty registration on the spot.
scenario: "Looking for a plancha BBQ for 6–8 people, gas, and easy to clean. What do you have?"

title: Outbound Lead Qualification
desc: Calls inbound demo requests within 60 seconds, qualifies budget / timeline / decision authority, and books a meeting directly into the rep's calendar.
scenario: Donna calls you back: "Hi, this is Donna from Voxdonna — saw you requested a demo two minutes ago…"

title: Multilingual Customer Support
desc: Detects the caller's language automatically and switches mid-conversation if needed. Same agent handles English, French, and Italian customers with consistent brand tone.
scenario: Try switching languages mid-call: ask in English, then say "Pouvez-vous continuer en français ?"

title: MI Health Care Concierge
desc: A 24/7 concierge for care home facilities. Books visits, answers family questions about residents, captures medication refill requests, and routes urgent calls to on-call nursing staff — without ever putting families on hold.
scenario: "Hi, I'm calling about my mother in room 312 — can I schedule a visit for Sunday afternoon and check if she needs anything?"

title: Wire Rope Complaint Hotline
desc: Captures structured complaint intake — batch number, PO, defect, severity, photos — and creates a fully-populated Salesforce case with the right QA engineer assigned, in under 4 minutes.
scenario: "I have a wire rope from batch 24-A-9931 — three broken wires after only 800 hours on our 80-ton crawler crane. Need an engineer to call me back."

title: Spare Parts Ordering Hotline
desc: Takes 24/7 spare-parts orders for industrial OEMs — captures equipment serial, cross-references competitor SKUs (SKF, Timken, Dodge), confirms stock, and books expedited freight in under 60 seconds.
scenario: "My conveyor's down at the plant — I need a replacement seal kit for serial X-1188 by Friday morning. Can you ship overnight?"

title: Order Status & ETA Tracking
desc: Handles "where's my order?" calls in 45 seconds — reads live ERP shipment status, pulls carrier tracking, and proactively offers expedite or ship-to changes when delays are detected.
scenario: "Where is PO 88231? It was supposed to ship Monday and I haven't heard anything. We need it on site by Wednesday."

title: Warranty Claim Intake
desc: Takes warranty claims for heavy-equipment OEMs — captures PIN, hours, error codes, photos, and dealer of record so back-office can auto-code 75-85% of claims and auto-approve 40-70% in under a minute.
scenario: "My combine PIN 1234ABCD threw a fault code mid-harvest — engine died, won't restart. Need a tech in the field today, not next week."

title: Predictive Maintenance Dispatch
desc: Closes the loop between IoT sensors (Augury, Petasense, Fluke) and field tech dispatch — confirms alerts, captures access requirements, and books certified techs with parts pre-staged.
scenario: "Compressor 7B vibration alarm — Augury just flagged a bearing failure. Production line goes down in 4 hours if we don't intervene. Send someone."

title: AI Karyakarta — Election Campaign
desc: Donna explains how Voxdonna AI Karyakarta runs booth-wise voter outreach, GOTV, helpline, volunteer coordination, and surveys for Vidhan Sabha and Lok Sabha campaigns — ECI-compliant by design.
scenario: "We're running a Vidhan Sabha campaign with 2 lakh voters across 180 booths. How fast can Voxdonna go live and what about MCMC compliance?"

title: UP Transport — Yatri Sahayak (Siya)
desc: Hindi-first AI helpline introducing herself as Minister Shri Daya Shankar Singh ji's new initiative — handles driving licence, vehicle registration, UPSRTC bus, e-challan, road safety. Replaces 5+ fragmented helplines with one 24×7 voice line. Sovereign-stack ready for production.
scenario: "नमस्ते, मेरा driving licence तीन महीने से अटका है — Lucknow RTO में क्या status है?"

title: Joyalukkas — Festive Outreach (Aanya)
desc: Hindi-first AI outbound caller for luxury jewellery — personalized birthday, anniversary, festival (Akshaya Tritiya, Diwali, Onam, Eid), and VIP loyalty calls. Drives in-store visits with curated offers. Multilingual: Hindi, English, Tamil, Malayalam.
scenario: "नमस्ते राजेश जी, आपके जन्मदिन की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं — Joyalukkas Indiranagar store पर diamond jewellery पर 15% special discount Sunday तक valid है।"

title: MD Sports Customer Service
desc: Donna handles inbound calls for MD Sports (Medal Sports) across all brands — replacement parts, warranty claims (90 days NA / 2 years EU), assembly help, and retailer routing. Sold at Walmart, Costco, Target, Lowe's.
scenario: "Hi, I bought a Barrington billiards table at Costco three weeks ago. One of the leg levelers snapped during assembly. How do I get a replacement?"

title: Bollywood Voice Marketing
desc: Donna walks through Voxdonna's Bollywood-inspired AI voice marketing — 1:1 personalized outbound campaigns for offers, festive promos, channel partner activation, EMI reminders, and loyalty calls. SME to enterprise.
scenario: "We're a D2C fashion brand launching a Diwali sale to 80,000 past customers. Can Voxdonna do personalized voice calls in Hindi and Hinglish?"

title: TCG Real Estate — The Cliff Garden, Hinjewadi (Pune)
desc: Aanya calls fresh enquiries for TCG's 14.5-acre Hinjewadi project — knows the three RERA phases, the 1 BHK / 2 BHK inventory, IT-park distances and the public review pros and cons cold. Qualifies budget / configuration / timeline, then locks a sample-flat visit. English default, switches to Hindi mid-call.
scenario: "Hi, I work at TCS Hinjewadi and saw your ad. Looking at a 2 BHK around 70-80 lakhs in Phase 2A — what is the possession and can I see a sample flat this Saturday?"

title: Riya from Nebula Slice
desc: Riya calls warm leads about co-owning a slice of the Hawthorn Suites by Wyndham resort in Dwarka. She explains fractional ownership, the targeted 9.5% rental yield and entry from ₹1.68 lakh, answers questions from a fixed knowledge base, never guarantees returns, and books a 15-minute callback with a human advisor. AI-disclosed, no payment taken.
scenario: You called about Hawthorn Suites — okay, but how is a 9.5% return even possible, and what happens if I want my money back later?

title: Diya from HoseXperts
desc: Diya cold-calls leads for a 1979-founded industrial hose distributor and qualifies them — first confirming a genuine product need and that they're India-based, then capturing quantity, purchase timeline, industry, buyer type (OEM/reseller/contractor/end customer), company details and ship-to address before handing a clean lead to sales. Never quotes final specs or price.
scenario: I need a food-grade hose for a dairy line, about two-inch bore, hot CIP wash cycles — what do you have and can someone call me back with a quote?

title: Sarah from American Ratings
desc: Sarah handles inbound calls for the A-I-R-S™ Number — a verified business and individual identity recognized in 150+ countries. She qualifies the caller (individual or business, use case, decision maker, timeline), explains the value when asked, quotes only the $599 lifetime bundle, and books a discovery call with sales for genuine fits — confirming name, email and phone before handing off. Never invents pricing or promises outcomes.
scenario: Hi, I run a small consultancy and a few enterprise clients asked if we are verified — what is an A-I-R-S Number and how much is it?

title: TGI Fridays — Bottomless Margaritas (Neha)
desc: Neha calls past guests in warm Hinglish about the weekend Bottomless Margaritas offer — builds curiosity before the reveal, quotes the price once if asked, pivots to food and mocktails for non-drinkers, and sends a WhatsApp reservation link only after the guest says yes. Honours do-not-call on the first ask.
scenario: Unlimited margaritas? Kitne ka hai — aur weekend pe kaunse outlets mein chal raha hai?

title: Deltin — Room Booking (Kiara)
desc: Kiara books rooms for Deltin's casino resorts in Daman and Goa — guides guests to the right property, collects dates, room type and party size, and confirms a WhatsApp booking link. Switches between Hindi, English and Gujarati mid-call. Never quotes a final tariff, never touches payments.
scenario: અમે ચાર જણ છીએ, Friday થી two nights — Daman માં pool-facing room મળશે?

title: Ironvale Insurance — First Notice of Loss (Claire)
desc: Claire runs the after-hours claims line for a general insurer. She checks everyone is safe first, verifies the policy, captures the whole loss file — date, location, damage, third parties, FIR, drivable or towed — reads back a claim reference and sends the photo-upload link. Injury, legal notice or suspected fraud stops the checklist and goes straight to a human. She never says whether a claim is covered and never quotes a rupee.
scenario: My car got rear-ended at Baner Road about twenty minutes back. Nobody's hurt, but the boot is smashed in.
